title: Position
description:
A Position is the organizational position a Person fills — the kind of capacity Persons occupy. Examples: Underwriter, Doctor, ChargeNurse, LeadCounsel, SuperAdmin, Head of P&T. Positions are exercised within Groups (Underwriter operates within BankDepartment); the type-level Position-Group relationship is captured by `scope`.

Position is one of four noun primitives (alongside Resource, Person, Group). All four share the noun base shape: name, optional attributes[], optional actions[], optional parent. Position adds: scope, system, and resource-link fields. Actions on a Position cover org-admin lifecycle (Underwriter.Activate, Doctor.Certify) — not 'what an Underwriter does' (those are Operations on other nouns, assigned via Tasks).

name.description: The singular PascalCase name of the Position.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this Position's authority and purpose.

domain.description: The home Domain this Position belongs to, referenced by Domain `name` (the authored form of the primary `belongs_to` edge). Names a Domain in the document's `domain` root or flat `domains[]`.

scope.description: The Group type(s) this Position is exercised within. Single Group name (Underwriter scope: BankDepartment) or array of Group names (SuperAdmin scope: [Workspace, Tenant]). Positions with no scope are global. The validator resolves each entry to a Group declaration.

parent.description: Optional parent Position for hierarchy (SeniorUnderwriter.parent = Underwriter). A child with no `scope` inherits its parent's effective scope; a child that declares its own `scope` must be narrower-or-equal (sub-Group via Group.parent, equal Person, or array subset). Cycles are rejected. Action and Membership inheritance are intentionally NOT implied — children declare their own actions[] and Memberships reference Positions by exact name.

system.description: If true, this Position represents a non-human (system) actor — scheduled jobs, bots, integrations. System Positions are not eligible for Memberships (no Person fills them).

resource.description: Optional Resource template that backs this Position — used when a system Position is embodied by a Resource at another layer (e.g., NightlyDelinquencySweep backed by ScheduledJob, or ExternalCreditBureau backed by CreditBureau).

attributes.description: Fields that describe this Position template (rare — most Position detail lives in Memberships and authorities).

actions.description: Verbs supporting org-admin lifecycle on the Position itself (Underwriter.Activate, Doctor.Certify, Position.Retire). NOT what someone in this Position does — those are Operations on other nouns assigned via Tasks.

cardinality.description: Per-scope-instance Person count limit. "one" means at most one Person may hold this Position on any given scope instance at runtime; "many" (default) means unbounded. "one" requires a declared or inherited scope and is incompatible with system: true. The validator checks the declaration only — runtime systems enforce the count.

required.description: Whether at least one Person must hold this Position on every scope instance at runtime. Composes orthogonally with cardinality: { cardinality: 'one', required: true } means exactly one. Requires a declared or inherited scope and is incompatible with system: true. The validator checks the declaration only — runtime systems enforce presence.

excludes.description: Names of other Positions that the same Person SHALL NOT simultaneously hold on the same scope instance. Symmetric (one-sided declaration is enough). Both Positions must share at least one effective-scope entry. No self-reference. Incompatible with system: true. The validator checks well-formedness only — runtime systems enforce the constraint.

examples.name: LeadCounsel
examples.description: Lead attorney on a legal case.

examples.name: SuperAdmin
examples.description: Top-level admin within a Workspace or Tenant.

examples.name: NightlyDelinquencySweep
examples.description: Scheduled job that flags delinquent loans.
